dataset.name: smoke_synthetic
dataset.description: Synthetic cartoon mannequins for verifying the pipeline. NOT a benchmark: results on it say nothing about real-world accuracy.

metadata.reproducibility: Same dataset files, same seed and the same settings give the same splits, pairs and numbers. The fingerprint of each model is recorded under 'models'.

definition.impostor_comparisons: different-person photo pairs. For each of the 12 most alike pairs of people (ranked by their single most similar pair of photos, using the baseline model) the 2 most similar photo pairs are taken.
definition.genuine_comparisons: same-person photo pairs from different cameras (all of them, or a seeded sample of 4000 when there are more).
definition.inclusion_criteria: The impostor side is selected BY the baseline model's similarity, so it is hard for that model by construction. Another model is compared on the very same pairs, which is a fair stress test but not a random sample.
definition.model_vs_clothing: 'Similar' for mining means similar EMBEDDINGS. Clothing similarity is measured separately (colour histograms, label-free proxy) and reported per pair; the two are not assumed to coincide.
definition.clothing_proxy_rule: colour similarity in the top 25% of a seeded sample of all different-person photo pairs
definition.splits: people are divided into dev / calibration / test with no person in two groups; the threshold is chosen on calibration people only.

notes: The requested operating point could NOT be met on the calibration data (DIR@1 (accepted and correct) >= 90.0%, minimise FAR). The threshold shown is only a best-effort fallback (accept every query that scores at least as high as the lowest observed score) and must not be treated as calibrated.

challenge.note: The challenge-set FAR is measured on pairs chosen BECAUSE they are hard, so it is much higher than the false-accept rate of normal use. Compare it with the all-pairs reference, not with a target FAR.

model.name: osnet_ain_x1_0
model.weights_license: MIT (Torchreid); see training-data caveat in the README

improved.reason: No fine-tuned checkpoint was selected. None is shipped with this project; scripts/finetune_triplet.py trains one on the development people.

baseline.note: 'observed' holds recorded measurements. 'possible_causes' are hypotheses worded from those measurements; they have not been tested and must not be read as the proven reason.

limitations: Results are measurements on one sample of people. A threshold chosen on one calibration set does not guarantee the same false-accept rate on new people.
The challenge set is selected by the baseline model, so its false-accept rate is not comparable with a normal FAR; use the all-pairs reference for that.
Clothing similarity is a colour-histogram proxy. The datasets carry no clothing labels, so 'similar clothing' is not ground truth.
Possible causes listed for each mistake are hypotheses derived from recorded numbers; none has been tested by changing the input.
The dataset 'smoke_synthetic' is a smoke test set, not a public benchmark; its numbers verify the software only.
No improved model was compared, so this run makes no claim that any training method improves results.

The test split was searched for look-alikes after the threshold was fixed on calibration people. Do not adjust the model or threshold in response and then reuse the same test split for a final number.
warnings: 'smoke_synthetic' is a smoke test dataset: these results only show that the lab runs end to end. They are NOT benchmark results and must not be quoted as performance.

The baseline model could not reach the requested operating point on the calibration people (DIR@1 (accepted and correct) >= 90.0%, minimise FAR). Its threshold is a best-effort fallback, not a calibrated one.
